visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male host with short dark hair, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt and black trousers, stands in a brightly lit department store. He holds a professional microphone with a black wind muzzle and points to his jawline with a silver-braceleted hand. The background shows an Aesop retail counter and passers-by in the distance. (2) The scene transitions to the La Prairie beauty counter, characterized by sleek white furniture and illuminated blue product displays. A female consultant in a white top joins the host. They examine a tall, cobalt blue and silver bottle containing golden-colored spheres. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the host's hands as he demonstrates the product's 'activation' mechanism. He presses a silver button on top of the Skin Caviar bottle and shakes it vigorously. The golden spheres inside dissolve into a creamy white emulsion. (4) The host applies a dollop of the white serum onto the back of his hand, which features a minimalist line tattoo. He rubs the product in, showing a glowing, pearlescent finish on the skin. The consultant points to her own defined jawline while speaking. (5) The duo discusses a white tube of foam cleanser. The host squeezes a thick, white dollop onto his hand and manipulates the foam with his fingers to showcase a dense, whipped texture. (6) A final product demonstration involves a white hand cream tube. The host applies and massages the cream into his hands, gesturing towards the camera to show the moisturizing effect. (7) The host stands alone again, holding a grey La Prairie shopping bag. He waves and smiles at the camera as the scene fades into a black title card with white text.

A subtle 'pop' SFX accompanies the initial text animation. (2) A female voice enters the mix, exhibiting a polite and professional tone with clear articulation. The BGM maintains a consistent volume, providing a rhythmic backdrop to their dialogue about the classic serum. (3) A canned laugh track SFX is triggered momentarily during a humorous exchange between the host and consultant. High-pitched 'ding' SFXs are placed strategically to highlight key product features and on-screen text overlays. (4) The audio focus shifts to descriptive narration by the male host, who speaks at a faster pace while demonstrating the product. The acoustic texture is clean with high spectral brightness, typical of a well-produced social media vlog. (5) In the final phase, the male host's voice remains upbeat and authoritative, thanking the consultant. The BGM swells slightly in the mix before a quick hard cut to silence as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Feature Demonstration -> Testimonial/Result -> Value Proposition -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional product review for La Prairie skincare. It uses an energetic host and an expert consultant to validate the brand's luxury status, demonstrate specific application techniques for 'anti-gravity' effects, and highlight both high-end and entry-level options to appeal to a broad consumer demographic looking for effective beauty solutions.
